investigation_notes.Description: SharePoint logged 294 file downloads by acc_svc@globalcorp.ee from the DACH Finance site at 2026-03-01T15:10:00Z (Tallinn local time ~17:10). The downloaded files and paths are finance-related and align with an accounting/service account, the activity occurred during normal local business hours, and there are no recent related alerts or events. Although the volume is elevated (~11.8x the 24-hour baseline) and the user agent appears to be an automated HTTP client, the multiplier does not exceed the high-risk threshold and contextual signals do not indicate immediate compromise, so this is assessed as low priority.
